card.name: Digits inside phone numbers and measures
card.fires_on: A digit sitting inside a fixed numeric string, just before a separator such as a dot or hyphen. Typical cases are toll-free phone numbers, the 1.73 m2 in eGFR units, and table decimals.

modes.label: Poison control phone number
modes.description: Middle digit of the toll-free numbers 1-800-222-1222 and 1-800-422-6237.

modes.label: eGFR unit 1.73 m2
modes.description: The 1 at the start of 1.73 in mL/minute/1.73 m2 in kidney function tables.

modes.label: Numbers in tables and URLs
modes.description: A digit before a decimal point in a numeric table, or the query marker in a web link.

card.writes: It promotes separators and digits such as '/', '-', '+', '.', and '=', so the next character is likely a separator or digit.
card.plain: It marks a digit in a set number string, like a hotline number or the 1.73 in kidney function units, where a dot or dash comes next.
